messages:
sam: Dry-run failed for promo to eu-west. deploy-bot flagged a values schema mismatch in overlays/edgezone for the invoices chart. Can someone triage?

alina: On it. Error logs?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: DRY-RUN FAILED
service invoices: helm template failed merging overlays/edgezone.yaml
Command: helm upgrade --install invoices ./charts/invoices --dry-run --values values/eu.yaml --values overlays/edgezone.yaml
Error: key invoices.backoff is incompatible (expected integer or map, found string '5s')
CI: http://ci.internal/DRY-INV-341

sam: Looks like overlay used a duration string while chart expects a structured map. Auto-merge would silently coerce. We need a safe mitigation for tonight's window.

alina: Two quick options: 1) pin invoices chart to 4.1.0 and run a short canary, 2) apply a tiny hotpatch to normalize the overlay value to the expected map. Pin is lower blast radius.

infra-oncall: I'm online. Pin+canary sounds safest for the release window. If we hotpatch, we need a fast rollback plan.

ops-bot: k8s: recommend canary with 3 replicas and add extra probe timeout for exporter startup. Also monitor downstream billing calls for latency.

sam: Agree pin. We'll also open a follow-up ticket to add a "schema-guard" CI job that uses yq + a lightweight JSON schema to reject overlay merges with type drift.

alina: I'll push the pin. Commands I will run:
```
# pin chart
git checkout -b fix/edgezone-invoices-pin
yq e '.resources[0].chartVersion = "4.1.0"' -i overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml
git add overlays/edgezone/kustomization.yaml && git commit -m "pin invoices chart to 4.1.0 to avoid overlay values type drift" && git push origin fix/edgezone-invoices-pin
```
Requesting review from @sam.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR merged. Starting canary invoices@4.1.0 at 5% traffic. Canary id INV-341.

ops-bot: k8s: canary started: invoices-eu-canary x3 pods. Ready 3/3. Observing invoice submission flow and downstream billing.

sam: Drafting release notes blurb: - Temporarily pinned invoices chart to 4.1.0 due to values shape/type drift in edgezone overlay. Follow-up: hotpatch to migrate invoices.backoff to canonical map and add schema-guard CI.

ops-bot: canary @12m: p50 latency +2%, errors 0.0%, no increased failure to billing. Readiness 100%.

alina: Bumping to 30% traffic. deploy-bot: route-canary INV-341 set-traffic 30%

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: traffic updated to 30% for INV-341.

ops-bot: 30% at 10m: steady. No downstream alerts.

sam: If stable for another 15m, promote. Also creating the ticket for schema-guard: infra ticket INF-1298 (yq + jsonschema check).

ops-bot: canary 35m overall: stable. CPU at 60% of request, p95 latency unchanged.

alina: Promoting to 100% now. deploy-bot: promote INV-341

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: promoted canary INV-341 to stable invoices@4.1.0. Notifying release-notes-bot.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: Added entry 2024-11-30: 'Pinned invoices chart to 4.1.0 due to overlay values type mismatch in edgezone; hotpatch and schema-guard CI planned.'

ops-bot: prod rollout complete. pods ready 6/6. No incidents.

sam: Next steps: open INF-1298 (schema-guard), schedule a short hotpatch to normalize overlay, and add a short note to the ops runbook with rollback steps:
```
# rollback
prev=$(helm history invoices -n prod | sed -n '2p' | awk '{print $1}')
helm rollback invoices $prev -n prod
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/invoices
```

alina: Filed INF-1298 and assigned to infra team for next sprint. I'll link the migration PR once ready.

infra-oncall: Thanks folks. If the schema-guard lands, this should reduce late-window type drift.

sam: Closing this thread after release notes link posted.

release-notes-bot: release-notes-bot: https://releases.internal/notes/2024-11-30/invoices-pin
